name: abaqus-surrogate-fea-validation
description: Closed-loop inverse-design validation. Solve inverse problem on a Ridge surrogate (PGD / L-BFGS-B / multi-start / Nelder-Mead), run Abaqus FEA verification, and emit side-by-side surrogate-vs-true displacement metrics (MSE / MAE / NRMSE / saturated channels). Quantifies the surrogate-FEA gap before publishing claims or trusting an inverse-design solution.
